areas.new_evidence: Finite Bayes odds, quadrature/conjugacy, Jacobians and exact posterior-risk identities
Actual Metropolis sequence, leapfrog reversibility and SBC with an ignored-data counterexample
Actual model fits, diagnostics, predictive simulations, exact LOO/oracle decisions and GP covariance comparison
Real typed models, fixed bounded sampling, analytic reference quantities, hierarchical and censored likelihoods

boundaries: Short classroom chains do not certify convergence.
Constants can have undefined sampling diagnostics; zero rounded elapsed time can yield infinite ESS/sec.
The native Stan pad has transformed-data constants and no separate JSON editor.
The optional normal-mean project uses a real data block and explicit prepared CmdStanPy/CmdStan.
Calibration and numerical oracles establish bounded computational evidence, not external model validity.
